hadrek_quarryborn.name: Hadrek Quarryborn
hadrek_quarryborn.title: The Wall-Splitter
hadrek_quarryborn.description: A quarry slave who broke a siege ram with a maul and was freed for it.
hadrek_quarryborn.abilityDesc: Keystone Blow — bonus damage vs elites, brief pin.

osmar_tallgrave.name: Osmar Tallgrave
osmar_tallgrave.title: The Cairn-Maker
osmar_tallgrave.description: Buries the men he beats under stones while the crowd keeps count.
osmar_tallgrave.abilityDesc: Cairn Fall — smashes nearby foes on kill streak.

lord_corvane_ashgilt.name: Lord Corvane Ashgilt
lord_corvane_ashgilt.title: The Gilded Bastard
lord_corvane_ashgilt.description: A disinherited lord who fights in his dead father's gilt mail.
lord_corvane_ashgilt.abilityDesc: Herald's Boast — boosts ally morale in aura.

brunhal_oxmantle.name: Brunhal Oxmantle
brunhal_oxmantle.title: The Unfelled
brunhal_oxmantle.description: Left for dead on three fields, and walked off every one of them.
brunhal_oxmantle.abilityDesc: Stubborn Blood — heals when below 40% HP.

jorun_kestrelhand.name: Jorun Kestrelhand
jorun_kestrelhand.title: The Javelin of Spite
jorun_kestrelhand.description: Throws weighted javelins the way a hawk drops on a hare.
jorun_kestrelhand.abilityDesc: Stooping Cast — crit from high ground.

maldrick_sootgate.name: Maldrick Sootgate
maldrick_sootgate.title: The Gaoler
maldrick_sootgate.description: A soot-black gaoler who has never lost a prisoner.

alder_wynfast.name: Alder Wynfast
alder_wynfast.title: The Oathkeeper
alder_wynfast.description: Swore to hold a bridge for one night and held it for nine.
alder_wynfast.abilityDesc: Sworn Stand — damage reduction under 50% HP.

gorvan_hullbreaker.name: Gorvan Hullbreaker
gorvan_hullbreaker.title: The Bull of Marrowgate
gorvan_hullbreaker.description: A drover's son who fights like the herd he grew up under.
gorvan_hullbreaker.abilityDesc: Goring Sweep — aoE slam on attack.

ulvar_deepmoor.name: Ulvar Deepmoor
ulvar_deepmoor.title: The Fen Warden
ulvar_deepmoor.description: Chief of a marsh clan; he goes in first and shields whoever follows.
ulvar_deepmoor.abilityDesc: Shoulder Ram — charge attack with knockback.

sennet_quickheel.name: Sennet Quickheel
sennet_quickheel.title: The Tourney Darling
sennet_quickheel.description: A fairground tumbler turned duelist who ends fights with one kick.

hestor_grindlaw.name: Hestor Grindlaw
hestor_grindlaw.title: The Lockwright
hestor_grindlaw.description: A locksmith's apprentice who found every joint opens the same way.
hestor_grindlaw.abilityDesc: Lockwright's Hold — locks down one target.

brother_halvec.name: Brother Halvec
brother_halvec.title: The Bell of Low Hallow
brother_halvec.description: Tolls a hand-bell before he kills. Men have run from the sound alone.

varn_thistlehide.name: Varn Thistlehide
varn_thistlehide.title: The Troll-Flayer
varn_thistlehide.description: Wears a coat of troll quills and hunts things twice his size.
varn_thistlehide.abilityDesc: Barbed Hide — bonus vs larger foes.

big_oddo_of_cragfoot.name: Big Oddo of Cragfoot
big_oddo_of_cragfoot.title: The Walking Keep
big_oddo_of_cragfoot.description: A hill-giant's bastard, by his own telling. Nobody argues.

ilvane_whetstone.name: Ilvane Whetstone
ilvane_whetstone.title: The Patient Blade
ilvane_whetstone.description: Sharpens his sword between every bout, and during some.

durgan_beamshoulder.name: Durgan Beamshoulder
durgan_beamshoulder.title: The Lintel
durgan_beamshoulder.description: A hod-carrier who drops men the way a roof drops its beams.
durgan_beamshoulder.abilityDesc: Roof Fall — heavy splash on every fourth blow.

fenrick_barbtongue.name: Fenrick Barbtongue
fenrick_barbtongue.title: The Heckler
fenrick_barbtongue.description: Insults his way into every fight and wins most of them.
fenrick_barbtongue.abilityDesc: Barbed Tongue — buffs allies when he scores.

old_garth_bannerpole.name: Old Garth Bannerpole
old_garth_bannerpole.title: The Colour-Serjeant
old_garth_bannerpole.description: Carried a banner for thirty years and now fights with the pole.
old_garth_bannerpole.abilityDesc: Raise the Colours — rally pulse on wave start.

brask_ironbrow.name: Brask Ironbrow
brask_ironbrow.title: The Ram of Tanner's Row
brask_ironbrow.description: Settles arguments with his forehead. It has not lost one yet.

pip_wrenfall.name: Pip Wrenfall
pip_wrenfall.title: The Rope-Dancer
pip_wrenfall.description: The smallest champion in the hall, and never yet held down.
pip_wrenfall.abilityDesc: Rope-Dancer's Leap — evasion, hard to pin.

jessom_magpie.name: Jessom Magpie
jessom_magpie.title: The Light-Fingered
jessom_magpie.description: Cheats at dice, cards and combat, and admits to all three.
jessom_magpie.abilityDesc: Magpie's Due — steals TP on elite kill.

orrin_clampjaw.name: Orrin Clampjaw
orrin_clampjaw.title: The Vise
orrin_clampjaw.description: Says nothing and lets go of nothing.

tharn_ringholder.name: Tharn Ringholder
tharn_ringholder.title: The Unbeaten Novice
tharn_ringholder.description: The newest name on the hall's wall, and not yet crossed out.
tharn_ringholder.abilityDesc: Ringed In — bonus damage when surrounded.

gundrek_oxblood.name: Gundrek Oxblood
gundrek_oxblood.title: The Butcher of the Bloodsand
gundrek_oxblood.description: A slaughterman who never changed trades, only what he works on.
gundrek_oxblood.abilityDesc: Carcass Throw — ends wounded targets outright.

kerrin_ashvow.name: Kerrin Ashvow
kerrin_ashvow.title: The Hedge-Preacher
kerrin_ashvow.description: A defrocked preacher who ends sermons and fights the same way.
kerrin_ashvow.abilityDesc: Last Word — finisher on low HP targets.

merrow_slingstone.name: Merrow Slingstone
merrow_slingstone.title: The Poacher
merrow_slingstone.description: Took the king's deer with a sling for ten years before the hall took him in.

hulder_rustbeard.name: Hulder Rustbeard
hulder_rustbeard.title: The Peat-Cutter
hulder_rustbeard.description: Swings a peat spade wide enough for two.

old_mother_sedge.name: Old Mother Sedge
old_mother_sedge.title: The Bog Oracle
old_mother_sedge.description: Reads deaths in marsh-light and is seldom wrong about them.
old_mother_sedge.abilityDesc: Corpse-Candle Omen — fear aura blinds enemies; strongest when darkness falls.

hallec_stillwater.name: Hallec Stillwater
hallec_stillwater.title: The Still Hand
hallec_stillwater.description: Stands so still the crowd forgets him. So do his opponents.
hallec_stillwater.abilityDesc: Sudden Fall — strikes without warning; devastates wounded foes.
